content.name: Aditya Kulkarni
content.title: Principal Software Engineer
content.summary: Principal engineer with 14 years across lending, retail and payments platforms in Java and Go. Currently responsible for the UPI switch at a Pune payments company that clears 9 million transactions a day at 99.98% availability. Leads a 35-member engineering group and has built three teams from scratch.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Wrote the loan-origination workflow in Java and Spring for a co-operative bank client, taking approval turnaround from four days to six hours.
Integrated CIBIL credit-bureau lookups and automated eligibility rules, removing 70% of manual credit checks.
Moved from fresher to module owner in two years and trained the next batch of eight campus hires.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Re-architected the point-of-sale sync service for 3,400 kirana and mid-size stores to work offline for up to 48 hours.
Brought GST invoice generation in line with the 2017 rollout two weeks before go-live, with no billing downtime for clients.
Shrank average sync payload by 60% using delta encoding, which mattered for stores on 3G connections.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Built and led a 12-member team that delivered a teleconsultation platform handling 25,000 video consultations a day at peak.
Chose Go for the scheduling and notification services, reducing server count by a third compared with the earlier Node.js prototype.
Set up the engineering hiring process and closed 18 roles in a year with an offer acceptance rate of about 80%.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer
bullets: Own the architecture of the UPI switch processing 9 million transactions a day at 99.98% availability across three data centres.
Led a migration to active-active deployment that took recovery time for a regional outage from 40 minutes to under 3.
Manage a ₹6.5 crore annual infrastructure budget and cut per-transaction compute cost by 27% through capacity planning.
Run architecture reviews for five teams (35 engineers) and coach four tech leads.

achievements.title: Speaker at a national Java developer conference
achievements.detail: Presented on idempotency patterns in payment systems to about 400 attendees.

achievements.title: Engineering excellence award, Koregaon Health Platforms
achievements.detail: Awarded for scaling the platform during a fivefold demand spike without a major outage.
